name: write_symbol
description: Default primitive for safely editing one symbol or one text patch. Runs the full write pipeline: version conflict state machine (CLEAN / FILE_CHANGED_SYMBOL_STABLE / SYMBOL_CHANGED / SYMBOL_SIGNATURE_CHANGED / SYMBOL_DELETED / AMBIGUOUS_SYMBOL), file lock, validation (syntax + brackets), atomic temp+rename, synchronous reindex, undo journal (backup + state), pipeline trace. Non-code files: use edit_mode=patch with old_string/new_string. Always read_symbol first to obtain base_version. Do not use edit_transaction for a normal single-symbol edit.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

symbol_id.description: Stable symbol id (preferred). Read it from read_symbol output.

name.description: Symbol name (used with file_path when symbol_id unknown)

base_version.description: REQUIRED (unless allow_unsafe_no_base): the version object returned by read_symbol. Conflict adjudication anchor.

symbol.description: { body_hash, signature_hash } — symbol hashes from read_symbol

content.description: New content. For replace_symbol: the full new symbol (boundary=full) or new body (boundary=body).

old_string.description: Exact text to replace (must be unique in scope)

boundary.description: full (default): replace whole symbol. body: keep signature line, replace the rest.

preserve_decorators.description: Warn if content drops decorators that exist above the symbol (default true)

dry_run.description: Validate and produce diff without writing (default false)

allow_unsafe_no_base.description: Bypass base_version requirement (audited). Only for deliberate full-file overwrites.

block_on_validation_error.description: Block write if validation fails (default false)
